occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training-Required Topics in Health and Safety: During inspection, the director's proof of required annual traning in administering medication was not available for evaluation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training-Required Topics in Health and Safety (26 TAC §744.1311(d))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One of the six children's files evaluated during inspection did not include immunization documentation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §744.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Report Change in Director: The operations designated director has not been on staff at the operation since August of 2025. The former director is also still identified on the operation's Controlling Person's list. The operation has not notified Child Care Regulation of the change to the director's position in writing as of January 30, 2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Change in Director (26 TAC §744.303(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: Operational Policies was missing Parent Rights information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §744.501(17))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): During inspection, one caregiver did not have a notarized affidavit in file.

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Procedures parents access minimum standards online, TX A/N hotline, and HHSC website: Operational Policies were missing procedures for how parents can access minimum standards online and HHSC website.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures parents access minimum standards online, TX A/N hotline, and HHSC website (26 TAC §744.501(20))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Photo Identification: During inspection, one staff member did not have identification card on file.

occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §744.901(2))
